title: Red fire hydrant
summary: A glossy red street fire hydrant with a round cylindrical body, flared base and top flanges, domed cap, side nozzles, a large front cap, square nuts, bolt details, and hanging chains.
observations: Single solid object is a classic above-ground fire hydrant.
Dominant surface is bright red paint over the entire body, dome, caps, flanges, bolts, and chains.
Shape is mostly cylindrical with a flared circular base, a narrower lower barrel, a wider upper barrel, and a rounded domed top.
A large circular cap protrudes from the front, with smaller side nozzle assemblies visible at shoulder height.
Chains hang from the nozzle caps down toward the lower flange; small bolt heads ring the top and base flanges.
uncertainties: Only one angled view is shown, so the exact rear details and symmetry of the back side are not visible.
Dimensions are estimated from a typical sidewalk fire hydrant because no precise scale reference is present.
Fine chains, small bolt heads, paint chips, and shallow embossed lettering are approximated; tiny text should not be built literally.
